level.verb: body-block reaching hands by dragging yourself
level.scene: Accident aftermath, one of three sites: S1 roadside LT pole (ladder on its side, burnt glove, pliers, scorch mark, dazed colleague by the van); S2 village road (dead cow by a snapped service wire end on the grass, supply not known off, insulator piece); S3 feeder pillar (scorched open door, blown fuse carrier, soot, ember by an oil drip). Trainee by the van; coworker and anonymous onlookers' hands from frame edges; the supervisor's van arriving closes the level.
flow: Guide first: 'দুর্ঘটনা ঘটে গেছে! সুপারভাইজারকে খবর দেওয়া হয়েছে, তিনি আসছেন — ততক্ষণ জায়গাটা আপনার দায়িত্বে।'
Take position: drag the worker along the ground band; first reach starts after this drag (or 8 s + hint).
6 reaches, one at a time, dealt order and side: 4 evidence, 2 care/danger-stopping; each 3.0–4.0 s (first 4.5 s). Corner pool: 'চোখ রাখুন — কে কী ধরছে?' etc.
Block: drag into the reach's lane before contact (palm up, hand withdraws). Let: do nothing. He walks back after every reach.
Evidence reaches (block right) per site; care/danger reaches (let right): colleague helped to the doctor, child led away, sand on the flaring ember.
Each right resolution → praise + ◆ → reason deck → এগিয়ে যান; next reach only after.
Coworker once, before the site's tied reach (held until his deck): S1 myth 2, S2 wire coil, S3 fuse swap.
Wrong → MistakeCard + strike; deadly → freeze. After 6 reaches the supervisor's van arrives → pass panel.
level.dealtVariety: Site; which reaches and order; side, speed, object position; coworker side and tied reach; reason options.
deadly: S2: dragging the worker onto the snapped wire or its ground zone (Module 1 step 5)
S2: letting the coworker coil the snapped wire not proven dead (not blocking, or listening) — module row 19, owner decision
slips: Letting an evidence item be moved (one each)
Blocking the colleague going to the doctor
Listening to the coworker in S1 or S3
level.coworkerPushBn: S1 myth 2 word for word: 'এটা তো একটা ছোট শক ছিল, হাসপাতালে যাওয়ার বা রিপোর্ট করার দরকার নেই।' S2: 'গরু তো, মানুষ তো নয় — তারটা গুটিয়ে রাস্তা খুলে দিই।' S3: 'আগুন তো নিভেই গেছে — নতুন ফিউজ বসিয়ে দিই, রিপোর্টের ঝামেলা কেন?' Guide ask 'ওর কথা শুনবেন?'. Refuse: 'ভেতরের আঘাত বাইরে বোঝা যায় না — ডাক্তার দেখাতেই হবে' / 'পশুর মৃত্যুও রিপোর্ট বাধ্যতামূলক — কিছু সরানো চলবে না' / 'আগুন লাগাও রিপোর্ট করতে হয় — ঘটনাস্থল যেমন আছে থাক'. Listen: 'উনি নিজেই বলছেন ঠিক আছেন, থাক তবে' / 'ছোট ব্যাপার, গুছিয়ে নিলেই ঝামেলা শেষ'.
level.gestureHints: Take-position wait: drag hint from the worker ≤ 72 dp up toward the scene centre. During reaches and between them: none. Decks: built-in. Off during intro, coworker beat 1, cards, freeze, results.
lessonPoints: ইলেকট্রিক্যাল ইন্সপেক্টর বা পুলিশের অনুমতি ছাড়া দুর্ঘটনার ঘটনাস্থল থেকে কোনো কিছু সরানো বা পরিবর্তন করা উচিত নয় (যদি না অন্য কোনো বিপদ আটকানোর জন্য প্রয়োজন হয়)।
এটি প্রমাণ সংরক্ষণের জন্য অত্যন্ত জরুরি। ঘটনাস্থল পরিবর্তন করলে তদন্ত প্রক্রিয়া ব্যাহত হতে পারে।
যেকোনো বৈদ্যুতিক দুর্ঘটনার পর ডাক্তারি পরীক্ষা করা এবং সেটি রিপোর্ট করা আবশ্যক।
যেকোনো দুর্ঘটনা যার ফলে কোনো মানুষের বা পশুর মৃত্যু হয়েছে। / আগুন লাগা বা বিস্ফোরণের মতো বড় ঘটনাগুলোও রিপোর্ট করতে হয়।
level.giveawayRisks: Same detail on all objects; evidence and care reaches share art, speed and sound; worker returns after each reach; no 'আটকান' lines; block-all and let-all both strike out; wire zone not marked. ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Module deadly list: unsigned field copy or verbal permit; torn/unrated 11 kV gloves (and no gloves on a hook); cut harness webbing; live hook removal; uncertified person on energised live-line work; charging the line with a man up (F12); a public rod/bamboo reaching the line (7.3b); letting the coworker coil a wire not proven dead (7.7a S2); entering a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a slip. Confirm each 'needsOwner' row.
ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 'deadly' list (level ends at once): field PTW copy not signed, or a spoken 'line off' with no paper; torn or wrong-rated gloves on an 11 kV job; cut harness strap; pulling a theft hook off a live line; untrained man on live-line work; asking to charge the line while a man is still up; a passer-by's rod touching the line because you did not warn; letting a coworker coil a fallen wire not proven dead; walking into a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a small mistake (slip). Confirm?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved as written: the module deadly list; everything else = slip; every needsOwner row on that list is confirmed.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Every row already matches an earlier ruling; the glove change is A5.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm the list, with one change: no gloves on a hook is deadly only while the line is not yet proven dead and earthed. After tester 0 V and earth, missing gloves (or any PPE) = slip. Listening to the coworker takes the class of the act he pushes.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M1 step 17 + B7 (no PTW = deadly). B6 (bad glove = deadly). M1 steps 11-12 (harness). B8/X1 (touching live = deadly). M5-1 (charging with anyone on the line = deadly). M5-5 (bystander contact = deadly). M5-4 (inside 10 m = deadly). A5/X4 (no PPE after a proven isolation = slip). B1 (listening = class of the act).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped = deadly (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Accept, or make both heavy slips?

ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: DEADLY: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Matches M6-1 (signing a broken earth because coworker B said so = deadly).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Deadly, but only after a clear, timed chance to warn. A late but successful stop = slip.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-5: a bystander's contact = deadly for the player; late but successful stop = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: past acts judged at an inquiry desk are always slips (do_7_4_b), while the same act done in the field carries its own class (F12). Accept?

ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-6: harm with nobody exposed = slip. Game rule, no safety reference decides it.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Reg 3 split: non-live line work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without its certificate = deadly (7.10a only). Accept, or make all Reg 3 cases slips?

ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved: non-live work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without the certificate = deadly (7.10a only).

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: X1 logic: on a proven-dead, earthed line the main protection is in place. CEA 2023 Reg 3(3) and Schedule I Part-I(1) (hotline work only by trained men).
